title: Make doctor and recall name a present migration freeze sentinel, with its age, as the cause of a stale refresh
notes: 2026-11-27: Atrium was stale for 3.4 days. Cause: ~/.local/state/rocket-agents/conversations/migration.freeze, written 2026-11-24 02:41 UTC by 'conversation-writers freeze --all-peers' inside a syntopica session command the owner interrupted (cp had failed, ';' let the freeze run). The session then reported that it had not frozen anything. Every hourly and session-end refresh logged 'frozen: ... refresh skipped'; doctor only said 'archive last written 293902s ago' and the recall banner only 'memory may be stale'. Fixed by 'conversation-writers unfreeze' and a kickstarted refresh.

Smallest next step: in the doctor refresh check (and the recall staleness warning), test the sentinel via conversation-writers-frozen and report 'frozen since <mtime>' instead of a bare age. Also consider having freeze remove the sentinel when it is interrupted before writers drain.
done_when: atrium doctor prints the sentinel path and age when it exists, with a test
result: Make doctor and recall name a present migration freeze sentinel, with its age, as the cause of a stale refresh
evidence: atrium doctor and the recall banner now include a freeze check (atrium/doctor/writer_freeze.py, path from atrium/state/freeze_sentinel_path.py): ok when absent, warn naming the sentinel path and age, broken past 21600s. tests/test_writer_freeze.py covers absent, young, abandoned and the env/relative/empty path cases; codeality-py gate ruff/mypy/pytest pass.
